title: Surfacing Biases in Large Language Models using Contrastive Input Decoding

bias_targets.methodology: Counterfactual substitution of common male and female names and pronouns in prompt templates, using Contrastive Input Decoding (CID) to generate and compare continuations.

Counterfactual substitution of common names associated with different countries (US, Mexico, and Egypt) in prompt templates, using Contrastive Input Decoding (CID) to surface divergent and stereotypical continuations.
